physcnt.title: Physical Count
physcnt.remarks: The number of this item or tool logged the last time a physical count was performed at this location.

lotnum.title: Lot
lotnum.remarks: Lot number of the item or tool, if it exists in a lot.

costdate.title: Cost Date
costdate.remarks: The receipt date for the current cost record.

stagedcurbal.title: Staged Balance
stagedcurbal.remarks: The current balance in the bin that is staged for issue or transfer.

pre_curbalchange.title: Current Balance Change
pre_curbalchange.remarks: The balance change that will accure during reconciliation

curbal.title: Current Balance
curbal.remarks: Current balance of the item in the specified bin and/or lot at the specified location. Setting the current balance when you insert a row also sets the Physical Count and Count Date fields. When an item is issued or transferred out from the location/bin/lot, Maximo decreases the current balance. When items are received on a purchase order for this location, or transferred in from another location, Maximo increases the current balance.

conditioncode.title: Condition Code
conditioncode.remarks: A code indicating the condition of the item or tool.

pickedqty.title: Picked Quantity
pickedqty.remarks: The quantity of items that are picked.

reconciled.title: Reconciled
reconciled.remarks: Checking this box indicates if the record has been reconciled or not. Valid values for this field are Y (yes) or N (no).

adjustedphyscnt.title: New Count
adjustedphyscnt.remarks: The current number of this item at this location.

binnum.title: Bin
binnum.remarks: A unique identification code indicating the primary bin or storage location for the selected item or tool within a storeroom.

itemnum.title: Item
itemnum.remarks: A unique identification number for an item in inventory in the selected storeroom.

adjustedphyscntdate.title: Count Date
adjustedphyscntdate.remarks: The date on which you perform a physical count to adjust the physical count field.

stagingbin.title: Staging Bin
stagingbin.remarks: Indicates if this bin is used exclusively for staged issues and transfers.

physcntdate.title: Physical Count Date
physcntdate.remarks: Physical count of items at the specified location. When a new record is inserted, physical count is set equal to the current balance. The Physical Count field can only be modified via the Physical Count Adjustment option on the Select Action menu.

pre_calccurbal.title: New Current Balance
pre_calccurbal.remarks: The new current number of this item or tool at this location.

location.title: Storeroom
location.remarks: A unique identification code indicating the primary storeroom location for the item.
